name: Tigris Object Storage Free
free_limit: 5 GB Standard storage/month; 10,000 Class A (PUT/COPY/POST/LIST) and 100,000 Class B (GET/SELECT/other) requests/month; zero egress fees.
watch_out: Free storage covers Standard tier only. Usage beyond the allowance is billed; object notifications cost $0.01/1,000 events. Other storage tiers have separate retrieval fees or minimum retention periods.
